requests.scope: Authoritative open/closed production and other modal state
requests.extension: WorldView.activeInterface: string | null; WorldView.production: { interface: string; target: WorldTarget | null; recipes: Array<{ id: string; name: string; item: ItemView; allowed: boolean; reason: string | null }> } | null
requests.reason: An open_interface acknowledgement does not supply the active recipe menu, target, legal choices or concurrent/reconnect closure state. No client-side production grant or guessed guard is used.

requests.extension: WorldView.reward: { id: string; kind: 'quest' | 'level_up'; title: string; lines: string[]; items: ItemView[]; continuation: GameIntent | null } | null
requests.reason: QuestView.completed/journal and total XP do not identify the authoritative reward payload or its dismissal/queued-level-up sequence. The UI must not infer awarded quantities from unrelated state deltas or a fixture.

requests.scope: Selected combat style and exact source availability/visibility
requests.extension: PlayerView.combatStyle: string; PlayerView.interfaceStates: Array<{ id: string; visibility: 'hidden' | 'locked' | 'enabled'; highlighted: boolean; reason: string | null }>; PlayerView.prayers/spells: Array<{ id: string; allowed: boolean; reason: string | null }>
requests.reason: unlockedInterfaces and activePrayers do not encode the selected combat style, all guard-dependent ability availability, hidden versus locked states, or native tutorial highlights.

requests.scope: Inventory options not represented by existing intents
requests.extension: GameIntent variant { kind: 'item_action'; inventory_slot: number; action: string }
requests.reason: The public actions list can expose Drink, Bury, Read and other item operations, but the intent union only has equip/eat/drop/use-on-target. Mapping these to a fabricated self-use or an unrelated spawn is not legitimate.

requests.extension: GameIntent variant { kind: 'send_chat'; channel: string; text: string }
requests.reason: WorldView.messages is read-only and no public method submits chat. The current input/control explicitly reports this gap rather than silently accepting typing.

requests.extension: BankView tabs/activeTab/placeholders/insertMode; GameIntent variants for bank tab creation/assignment, placeholder changes, bank reorder, deposit-equipment and empty-container operations
requests.reason: Existing bank_deposit and bank_withdraw cover ordinary item amounts and notes, not these distinct source controls. Their buttons remain present and report missing capability.

requests.extension: PlayerView.equipmentStats and weight, or an approved complete UI derivation input; WorldView.keptOnDeath: { kept: ItemView[]; lost: ItemView[]; fee: number | null } | null; RecoveryView.cofferBalance and discard/recovery option intents
requests.reason: Current equipment identities and RecoveryView rows are insufficient for all effective bonus, kept-on-death, coffer and discard presentations. No fixture zeros or guessed recovery prices are displayed as authoritative values.

requests.extension: AppState.appearanceOptions: Record<string, Array<{ value: number; label: string; allowed: boolean }>> | null; AppState.audioSettings: { music: number; effects: number; area: number; muted: boolean; currentTrack: string | null }
requests.reason: The validated content currently supplies body_type 0/1 only. soundEnabled and setters do not expose actual saved channel values, track/playlist state, or all source appearance choices. Renderer preview uses the separate documented presentation hook.

requests.scope: Dynamic minimap and native tutorial map visibility
requests.extension: A renderer/shell minimap surface adapter carrying current base tile, plane and source mask state, or WorldView.minimap with equivalent authoritative metadata
requests.reason: Static original scene rasters plus live entity markers do not establish changing door/instance geometry or exact source tutorial map visibility. No observed live minimap state is invented.

implementation_gaps_without_contract_ext: Native prayer/spell filter controls and their distinct source layouts.
Complete native recovery grid/fee/discard layout calibration.
All required live-data source comparisons, selected/disabled/scroll variants and full tutorial UI projections.
Native authentication-failure/terms and animated-title variants beyond the implemented approved source-framed screens.
Remaining zero-tolerance native sprite/label differences recorded by the source comparator.
